includes: Licensed and United States Coast Guard Approved Captains
blurb: Sonny's Beach Service offers parasailing over the Gulf of Mexico with licensed and US Coast Guard approved captains. They also provide banana boat rides and beach rentals including chairs and umbrellas. The company has over 40 years of experience and operates on the beach in front of major resorts and hotels in South Padre Island.
